title: ACH Payment Credit on Rental Upgrade Difference Charges
content:
A Rental Property Service Contracts upgrade difference charge carries an autopay credit read from the contract's own payments.

| Premium payments posted on the contract by ACH in the 3 months before the charge | Returned payment billed back on the contract in the 12 months before it | Autopay credit |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | none | 0.03 |
| two or more | one or more | 0.01 |
| fewer than two | any | 0 |

**Records read.** The premium payments in the contract's billing history with their payment method and posting dates; the returned payment charges and their dates.

**How the credit acts.** Concessions and credits on an upgrade difference charge are subtracted from one and a loading is added, all in one sum, and the charge is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

*Hypothetical:* three ACH payments in the 3 months and no return in 12 months: 0.03. One ACH payment and two by check in the 3 months: 0.
